decision.reason: [ev-2e05a423eff6] states the subject and change clearly: in v2, an XR can compose any resource, including MRs, Kubernetes resources like a Deployment, and third-party CRs. It also says Crossplane must be granted access to compose resources that aren't Crossplane resources. But it doesn't say how to grant that access or what happens if access isn't granted. For both, it points to composition documentation that isn't shown here. Without that, an engineer can't write the applicability condition (which grants or configurations matter) or the consequence (what fails, if anything, when the operator does nothing).
